clue.text: Flamboyant bachelor's game has no limits

parts.note: BA, Bachelor of Arts, is a bachelor's degree

indicators.note: having no limits means losing the outermost letters at each end of the game's name

parts.note: croquet is the lawn game played with mallets and hoops

explanation.surface: A showy single man plays a game that has no boundaries.
explanation.walkthrough: 'has no limits' strips C and T from CROQUET, leaving ROQUE.
explanation.definitionFit: Baroque describes the ornate, extravagant style of 17th-century art and music, hence flamboyant.

clue.text: Provides the money to move Times?

parts.note: to budge is to move slightly
T is the abbreviation for time, so times is TS

explanation.surface: A question of who funds a change in the times.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Times' looks like the newspaper, but is just the plural of T, time.
explanation.definitionFit: To budget is to allocate or provide funds for something.

clue.text: How to be green on bike

parts.note: re means on or about, as in a memo
a cycle is a bike

explanation.surface: Riding a bike as a way to be eco-friendly.
explanation.definitionFit: Recycling waste is a standard way to be environmentally friendly, or green.

clue.text: Piece of card

definitions.meaning: a playing card between jack and king

explanation.surface: A piece of card.
explanation.definitionFit: A queen is both a chessman and a court card in a pack of cards.

clue.text: Feathers end up exciting wonder

indicators.note: up in a down entry means the word for end is written from the bottom up

parts.note: to die is to end

indicators.note: exciting means stirring up the letters of wonder

explanation.surface: Feathers end up arousing amazement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns DIE into EID; 'exciting' rearranges WONDER into ERDOWN.
explanation.definitionFit: Eiderdown is the soft breast feathers of the eider duck, used to fill quilts.

clue.text: Champion footballer I see

parts.note: Lionel Messi is the Argentine footballer
'ah' is what you say when you understand: 'I see'

explanation.surface: Someone acknowledges a footballer as a champion.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Champion' is a noun here: one who champions or saves a cause.
explanation.definitionFit: A messiah is a saviour or champion of a people or cause.

clue.text: Add up 1 + 100 to get score

indicators.note: up in a down entry means the word for add is turned upward

parts.note: to sum is to add
I is the Roman numeral for one
C is the Roman numeral for a hundred

explanation.surface: A sum: add up numbers to get a score.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns SUM into MUS. 'score' looks like a total in the arithmetic but means written music.
explanation.definitionFit: A score is the written music of a composition, so it stands for music.

clue.text: Very Liberal women labouring to secure victory promise

parts.note: so means very, as in 'so good'

indicators.note: to secure means the rearranged women hold the victory letter
labouring means working, so the letters of women are worked into a new order

explanation.surface: Liberal women campaign hard to secure a pledge of victory.
explanation.walkthrough: 'labouring' anagrams WOMEN to EMNOW, and 'to secure' puts V within it.
explanation.definitionFit: A solemn vow is a serious, formal promise.

clue.text: Great number going for river plunge

indicators.note: going for means one letter is exchanged in favour of another

parts.note: immense means great

explanation.surface: A huge number of people go to the river to take a dip.
explanation.definitionFit: To immerse something is to plunge it into liquid.

clue.text: Names on doors?

definitions.meaning: a handle is a name, especially a nickname

explanation.surface: Nameplates on doors.
explanation.definitionFit: Handles are slang for names and also the grips fitted to doors.

clue.text: Indeed, cornet's not even ordered

indicators.note: the clue's 'Indeed' is split as 'In deed', so the next letters go into the word deed

parts.note: a deed is taken as written

indicators.note: not the even letters means keeping only the odd-placed letters of cornet

explanation.surface: Someone remarks that a cornet is out of order.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Indeed' must be read as 'In deed': CRE, the odd letters of 'cornet' ('not even'), goes into DEED.
explanation.definitionFit: To decree is to order officially, so decreed matches ordered as a past tense verb.

clue.text: Single male working as wise guy

parts.note: solo means single or alone
on means working, as a machine that is on

explanation.surface: A single man at work posing as a know-all.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wise guy' usually means a smart alec; here it is literal.
explanation.definitionFit: King Solomon of the Bible is proverbial for his wisdom.

clue.text: Clapton covering 10cc? Strangely offbeat

indicators.note: covering means the guitarist's name wraps around the other letters

parts.note: Eric Clapton is the rock guitarist

indicators.note: strangely signals that the letters of ten and cc are put in an odd order

parts.note: 10cc is spelt out as ten and cc

explanation.surface: A guitarist covering a song by the band 10cc sounds strangely offbeat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'covering' looks like a musician's cover version, but it is the container signal; 10cc, the 1970s band, is read as TEN + CC before 'Strangely' rearranges it.
explanation.definitionFit: Offbeat means unconventional or odd, a synonym of eccentric.

clue.text: Flower completes Monet's first artwork

indicators.note: completes means the river follows and finishes off that letter
first means only the opening letter of Monet's is taken

parts.note: a flower is something that flows, a river: the Ural

explanation.surface: A flower finishes off Monet's first painting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Flower' is crossword code for a river, here the Ural.
explanation.definitionFit: A mural is a work of art painted directly on a wall.

clue.text: In Exodus, he battles biblical kingdom

indicators.note: in means the answer sits inside the run of words that follows

explanation.surface: A Bible reader notes that he fights battles in the Book of Exodus.
explanation.definitionFit: Sheba was an ancient kingdom whose queen visited Solomon in the Bible.

clue.text: Team having only clubs?

definitions.meaning: clubs and spades are black suits, so a hand of clubs is all black

explanation.surface: A sports team that owns nothing but clubs.
explanation.walkthrough: The ALL BLACKS are the New Zealand rugby union team; 'clubs' suggests golf, but it is the black card suit.
explanation.definitionFit: The All Blacks are a famous national sports team, named for their black kit.

clue.text: Surveys struggles to capture wicket after six balls

indicators.note: after means the struggling part comes behind the six balls

parts.note: in cricket an over is a set of six balls

indicators.note: to capture means the struggling word takes the wicket letter inside it

parts.note: vies means competes or struggles
W is the cricket abbreviation for wicket

explanation.surface: A cricket report: a bowler struggles to take a wicket after an over.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket an OVER is six balls bowled by one bowler.
explanation.definitionFit: Overviews are general surveys of a subject, so the plural nouns match.

clue.text: Occupy harbour

definitions.meaning: to ... children is to occupy or amuse them
to ... a thought is to harbour it

explanation.surface: Occupy the harbour.
explanation.definitionFit: Entertain means both to keep amused and to hold an idea in mind.

clue.text: Old, old idea by alien to construct a distant Earth?

parts.note: ex means former or old
a plan is an idea or scheme
ET is the film alien

explanation.surface: An alien uses an outdated idea to build a faraway planet.
explanation.definitionFit: An exoplanet is a planet orbiting another star, possibly an Earth-like world far away.

clue.text: Before retailer collapsed, Tesla quit

indicators.note: collapsed means the retailer falls into a jumble of its letters

parts.note: T is the symbol for the tesla, the unit of magnetic flux density

explanation.surface: Before a car dealer went bust, Tesla pulled out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'quit' says the T for tesla leaves the letters of RETAILER before they are rearranged ('collapsed').
explanation.definitionFit: Earlier means at a previous time, so it can replace before as an adverb.

clue.text: During Monopoly, MP usually makes a mountain

indicators.note: during means the answer is found within the words that follow

explanation.surface: In a game of Monopoly an MP usually builds a pile of money.
explanation.definitionFit: Olympus is the mountain in Greece said to be home of the gods.

clue.text: One serving drinks spills one drink

indicators.note: spills means the server lets go of one letter

parts.note: a waiter is someone who serves drinks
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A waiter spills a customer's drink.
explanation.definitionFit: Water is the most basic drink of all.

clue.text: Very extrovert principal wearing fancy shirt with flourishes

indicators.note: wearing means the rearranged shirt goes around the other letters
fancy means the letters of shirt are elaborately rearranged
principal means the first, leading letter of extrovert

explanation.surface: A flamboyant head teacher in a fancy shirt with frills.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fancy' makes THRIS from SHIRT; 'wearing' sets VE inside it. 'flourishes' looks like decorative frills but is the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To thrive is to flourish or prosper, both third person singular verbs.

clue.text: Makes noise like Brand and Bertrand, say?

indicators.note: say means the word is spoken rather than written

parts.note: comedian Russell Brand and philosopher Bertrand Russell are both Russells

explanation.surface: Two famous men noisily compared.
explanation.definitionFit: Rustles means makes a soft crackling noise, like dry leaves.

clue.text: Magnificent devoted leader changing sides

indicators.note: the leading letter changes from left to right, L for R

parts.note: loyal means devoted

explanation.surface: A faithful leader defects to the other side.
explanation.walkthrough: L and R are the abbreviations for left and right.
explanation.definitionFit: Royal can mean splendid or magnificent, fit for a monarch.

clue.text: Sacks carrying trade explosives

indicators.note: carrying means the sacking word holds the trade inside it

parts.note: to fire someone is to sack them
work is a trade or job

explanation.surface: A boss sacks workers carrying explosive goods.
explanation.definitionFit: Fireworks are devices filled with explosive powder for displays.

clue.text: Unites English in trouble

indicators.note: in means the English letter sits inside the trouble

parts.note: fuss means bother or trouble

explanation.surface: English people unite when there is trouble.
explanation.definitionFit: To fuse things is to join or unite them, both third person singular verbs.

clue.text: Connected to the internet, tense with excitement

explanation.surface: Getting online with nervous excitement.
explanation.definitionFit: Wired means both linked by cable to a network and keyed up or hyperactive.

clue.text: Politician's function to stop terrorists' influences

indicators.note: to stop means the politician and function plug the gap within the group's letters

parts.note: IS is the abbreviation for the terrorist group Islamic State
an MP is a Member of Parliament
an act is a function or action

explanation.surface: A politician's role is to halt terrorists' influence.
explanation.definitionFit: Impacts are effects or influences, matching the plural noun.

clue.text: Start with 1 + (2 x 22) + 4 + 1 + 50

parts.note: A, as one, the first letter
22-across is ROYAL, abbreviated R as in RN, Royal Navy; two times that is two Rs
IV is the Roman numeral for four
A, as one
L is the Roman numeral for fifty

explanation.surface: A sum to start: a string of arithmetic.
explanation.walkthrough: The sum is in symbols: 22 refers to 22-across, ROYAL, which as an abbreviation is R.
explanation.definitionFit: An arrival is the start of someone's stay or presence; Handel's 'Arrival of the Queen of Sheba' ties to the theme.

clue.text: Fights against spoilt sisters

indicators.note: spoilt means the letters of sisters are ruined into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone fights against spoilt sisters.
explanation.definitionFit: To resist is to oppose or fight against, both third person singular verbs.

clue.text: Fanatical about dressing in some tops? Not these

indicators.note: about means the crazy word goes around the letters picked next

parts.note: nuts means crazy or fanatical

indicators.note: tops means the top, or first, letters of dressing, in and some

explanation.surface: Fashion lovers obsess over wearing certain tops, but not these people.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tops' looks like clothing but asks for the leading letters; 'Not these' defines people who wear no tops at all.
explanation.definitionFit: Nudists wear no clothes, so they are the people not dressing in any tops.
